title: Foundation
author: Isaac Asimov
summary: A mathematician predicts that the vast galactic empire will fall and that a dark age of thirty thousand years will follow. He sets up a hidden colony of scholars at the edge of space to shorten that age to one thousand years.
readIf: you like big ideas about history and society, told as a series of clever crises.
skipIf: you want a single hero and emotional depth, as the cast changes across decades and mostly talks its way through trouble.

pairings.reason: Another grand story about the fall and rebuilding of a galactic empire, with more atmosphere and personal drama.
The same author's stories of logic puzzles and ideas, in a smaller and more playful form.
A modern book of big-scale ideas about civilisations and survival, with more sense of dread.
